text: If you eat, say the name of God, eat with your right hand, and eat from what comes next to you
If one of you eats food, let him say: In the name of God, and if he forgets the beginning, let him say: In the name of God, at the beginning and the end.

Whoever God feeds with food, let him say: O God, bless us with it, and feed us with something better than it. And whoever God gives him milk to drink, let him say: O God, bless us with it and give us more of it.
source: Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi with this wording

text: If one of you eats food, he should not eat from the top of the plate, but from the bottom; The blessing descends from above
If one of you eats food, he should not wipe his fingers until he has licked or licked them
If one of you eats food, and a morsel falls out, let him scoop out whatever dirt he got from it, then eat it, and do not leave it to Satan.
